brandDirectionNotes: Humor may invite participation while the evidence, questions, scoring and citations retain their independent review requirements.
Prefer jokes about the experience of voting, reading long programmes or election nerves over allegations about parties or politicians.
Nonpartisan intent is a qualitative naming judgment. Do not describe every expression as politically unassociated or as a verified viral meme.
Most new names are original meme-style adaptations; only cited expressions are described as documented references.
Estamos Jodidos is retained as the user's benchmark. Jodidos Pero Votamos is a participation-focused alternative, not a fact about every party.
The website helps prepare a decision and does not accept, count or verify actual ballots.
All prior names, earlier shortlist IDs, source files and recorded conflicts are preserved. Earlier favorites retain their stable IDs.
The user's favored domain spelling is nosvemosenlasurnas.es, with plural urnas; do not silently replace it with the earlier singular proposal.
Blunt humor is an explicitly requested exploration. Keep voting encouragement and source-based comparison central; candidate names do not assert that every party is corrupt.
The leading candidate is a recorded preference, not approval to buy a domain, create a named application or publish.
